description: Develop an initial, extensible set of use cases defining stakeholders' data and information needs
evidence: UC Berkeley/CCST 'Data for Water Decision Making' (Jan 2018) developed 20 initial use cases.

description: Identify and publish a list of water datasets from use cases
evidence: The same 2018 report synthesized data needs; no standing published list of use-case datasets found.

description: Develop protocol for writing use cases from pilot lessons
evidence: No use-case writing protocol found.

description: Continually collect and publish use cases and data needs
evidence: Use cases now arrive through Consortium projects (groundwater accounting, urban water reporting) rather than a state solicitation.

description: Inventory and publish list of water datasets with collecting agency and purpose
evidence: DWR Implementation Journal reports 2,700+ 'critical water and ecological datasets'; departmental inventories exist (CDFW BIOS, DWR and SWRCB dashboards).

description: Identify data needed but not collected for use cases
evidence: No AB 1755 gap analysis found. The SB 19 Stream Gaging Prioritization Plan (2022) is the closest sector-specific gap analysis.

description: Prioritize existing datasets to publish on an open data platform
evidence: 'Critical datasets' were designated for the Sept 2019 deadline; prioritization method not published.

description: Support agency requests to create or expand collection to fill gaps
evidence: SB 19 (2019) and the 2022 Water Supply Strategy target 430 new gages, but installation was not funded in the 2022 budget.

description: Improve data coordination among all organizations
evidence: Partner Agency Team, Water Data Advisory Council (2019), and the Consortium (2020) all coordinate; no statewide coordination of collection.

description: Protocols for creating or expanding data collection programs
evidence: No protocol for new data collection programs found.

description: Report on opportunities to streamline local agency reporting requirements
evidence: No streamlining report found. Water Resilience Portfolio action 22.3 (2020) restated the goal; Consortium urban water reporting work is related.

description: Publish minimum publication protocols: metadata, data dictionary, methods
evidence: Three minimum protocols (data steward; publish and document; access) issued Jan 2018, finalized Apr 2018.

description: Leverage OWIA to help stewards transform and standardize datasets
evidence: OWIA v2.0 requirements (Jan 2018) were not carried forward; federation of existing CKAN portals took its place. (Atlas draft judgment.)

description: Governance structure and process to guide protocol evolution
evidence: Water Data Advisory Council (2019) and Consortium (2020) created, but neither governs protocol evolution.

description: Implement governance, stakeholder and third-party recommendations
evidence: Ten protocol topics listed 'to be developed' in Apr 2018 (security, federation, interoperability, QC…); none found adopted. Journal still 'exploring' standards in 2023–24.

description: Expand use of data.ca.gov, data.cnra.ca.gov and others to publish AB 1755 datasets
evidence: data.cnra.ca.gov launched Mar 2018; 21,451 datasets on 2026-10-02.

description: Functional and technical requirements for the platform
evidence: April 2018 decision to federate existing portals rather than issue an RFP for a new platform made separate requirements moot.

description: Can existing portals meet the requirements?
evidence: Evaluated and chosen: existing portals (data.ca.gov + data.cnra.ca.gov) serve as the platform.

description: Initial enhancements based on functional requirements
evidence: 2019 federation harvests (Ocean Data Partners, Water Data Partners) added ~17,000 records; no published enhancement list.

description: Continually enhance the platform from user and governance input
evidence: Catalog keeps growing (≈ +2,000 since 2020); no public roadmap.

description: Federate federal datasets named in the statute
evidence: Federal records federated by 2020: Water Data Partners 1,410; NOAA 152; USGS 86; USFWS 35; USBR 9; USFS 2. Keyword harvest; Journal says selection needs refining.

description: Federate with other open data platforms
evidence: data.cnra.ca.gov federates to data.ca.gov (3,100+ records, 2024).

description: Improve metadata for discoverability
evidence: No metadata enhancement program found.

description: Adopt subject-matter controlled vocabulary
evidence: No adopted controlled vocabulary found.

description: Adopt geo-referencing best practices
evidence: No adopted geo-referencing guidance found.

description: Guidance for organizing a dataset and its resources
evidence: No dataset-organization guidance found.

description: Maintain master list of keywords and categories
evidence: Keyword tagging drives federal harvests; Journal acknowledges keyword selection needs refining.

description: Collect and implement stakeholder data-format improvements
evidence: No format-feedback process found.

description: Query and download like data through a single access point
evidence: One catalog search spans both portals; no cross-dataset query of like data.

description: Simple visualization tools for the platform
evidence: CKAN previews; ~20 visualizations on CNRA portal in 2018.

description: Annual report on dataset use
evidence: No annual dataset-use report found; Consortium published one-off usage figures (~2022).

description: Filter, query and subset-download tools
evidence: CKAN API and DataStore support filtering, querying and subset download on both portals.

description: Third-party apps and decision-support tools; feature them on rotation
evidence: Water Data Challenges (2018, 2019) and the open-source Groundwater Accounting Platform (2021).

description: Analytical sandbox for the water community
evidence: No analytical sandbox found.

description: Map app to discover datasets across federated platforms
evidence: No map-based discovery app across federated portals found.

description: Archive datasets on the open data platform
evidence: No archiving policy found for platform datasets.

action: Pilot Projects and Interoperability Test Beds
description: Pilot early use cases; survey users for feedback
evidence: Pilots came later via the Consortium (Groundwater Accounting Platform 2021; IoW pilots incl. FHAB ingestion framework).

description: Publish pilot lessons learned
evidence: No published pilot lessons-learned found.

description: Communications and engagement strategy
evidence: Public meetings, Implementation Journal story map (2019–2024), Consortium events (e.g., Data for Lunch).

description: Training resources for data consumers
evidence: Water Resilience Portfolio 22.1 (2020) restated AB 1755 data training; delivery not verified.

description: Training for partner agencies publishing data
evidence: No data-steward training found.

description: Foster a data steward user group
evidence: No state user group found; Consortium working groups (LiDAR, telemetry, groundwater) fill part of the role.

description: Sustainable governance and funding structure
evidence: Governance: Consortium launched June 2020. Funding: Water Data Administration Fund never capitalized; only AB 1755 line item found is $800k (2018-19).

description: Usage statistics and success stories
evidence: Consortium published usage figures once (~2022: 73,934 users); no ongoing metrics.

description: Recommend platform, documentation, tool and reporting improvements
evidence: Consortium 'Putting Data to Work' (Feb 2023) made 6 recommendations.

description: Solicit feedback from managers and users
evidence: No systematic feedback mechanism found.

description: Encourage decision-support tools built on platform data
evidence: Groundwater Accounting Platform; data-challenge entries.

description: Encourage publications to cite platform data
evidence: No guidance to cite platform data found.

description: Data challenges, competitions, hackathons
evidence: Safe Drinking Water Data Challenge (2018), Water Data Challenge (2019), 10-year showcase (2026).
